en-US.title: Deckhead
en-US.subtitle: Charades Party Game
en-US.promoText: Phone on your forehead. Your friends yell clues. One tap to play, every deck free, and streaks to keep alive.
en-US.description:
Hold the phone to your forehead. A word pops up that everyone can see except you. Your friends yell clues, act it out, hum it — anything but say the word — and you get as many as you can before time's up.

ONE TAP TO PLAY
Swipe through decks like lenses and hit the button. You're playing. Want teams and house rules? They're one tap away.

EVERY DECK IS FREE
No ads. No subscriptions. No in-app purchases. No account.

MAKE YOUR OWN
Your friend group's inside jokes. Your teachers. Your dorm. Type a few cards or paste a whole list.

SHARE IN SECONDS
Show a code and the whole room has your deck. Or send a link or a file — it all travels inside the code, so nothing gets uploaded anywhere.

STREAKS AND BADGES
Keep your 🔥 streak alive, chase your best round, and unlock badges as you play.

CONTROLS THAT WORK
Tap the top of the screen if you got it, the bottom to pass. Giant targets you can hit without looking. Prefer tilting? Turn it on — it's built to ignore an excited jerk of the phone.

A GAME WITH AN ENDING
Play as one big group or split into teams. Pick a number of rounds, a target score, or play till the cards run out. Fix a mis-tap after every round.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Deckhead works fully offline and collects nothing. Your decks, games and streak stay on your phone.
en-US.releaseNotes: A whole new look. Swipe between your decks, Play and You, start a game in one tap, and keep your streak alive.
